enchantments.tooltip: Strength +8: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Constitution +8: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
